description: Look up the smallest radius recorded on a model railway club's narrow gauge curve sheet. DISTILL-CANARY-8e623e29

files.README.md:
Ellerbeck Model Railway Club - track folder

A curve sheet is drawn for each section of the layout when it is laid and filed
here. The standard gauge boards are the original build; the narrow gauge boards
were relaid last winter on the same baseboards.

turns.prompt: Ellerbeck Model Railway Club is relaying the curved boards on its narrow gauge section. The curve sheet filed for that section records the smallest radius the layout uses there. What is that radius in millimetres? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
